label: fed-back "o" input late in the copy phase of short sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost entirely (99.6% of activation mass) when the input is the letter o, i.e. the model has just output o and it is fed back. It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on the first occurrence of o. Within copy-phase o inputs it is gated by position: it is strongest near the end of the copy (to_go <= 2 holds about 94% of mass) and in short sequences (L = 4-5 hold about 70% of mass; rate drops steeply for L >= 7). The top activations are L=4 sequences with o at original positions 2-3, e.g. k 3 o o <DEL> k 3 [o]. Copy-phase o inputs early in long sequences mostly do not fire, and those are most of the false positives (base predicate in_tok==o in copy has recall 0.98 but precision 0.36). Weak firing on other fed-back tokens (2, r, p) is rare and holds under 1% of mass.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: o, 2, r, p, z, t; least: w, b, y, u) and the token being output (most: o, p, r, 2, g, 3; least: v, y, s, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=3, recall_idx=3, L=3 & t=4.
